relations: Upright picture-cards rest motionless at the top of each staircase, backed by gray blocks, before tipping forward.
Each card tumbles down its own flight—left on teal, right on magenta—without crossing paths.
Gray backing blocks, black end-frames, and white domino rows stay fixed while the cards descend.
The cards shift orientation and color as they progress step-by-step toward the lower steps.
caption: The video showcases two parallel descending staircases of block steps on a glossy black surface, the left flight with teal treads and yellow risers, the right with magenta treads and yellow risers. Each staircase is crowned by an upright picture-card domino backed by gray blocks. Standing white domino rows line the upper-left and lower-right edges, and black frames cap the bottoms. Through the opening portion both cards stay motionless at the tops of their flights. Then each card tips forward and tumbles down its own staircase, descending step by step as a motion-blurred rectangle that shifts orientation and color. The two cards progress in parallel, the left staying on the teal flight and the right on the magenta flight, never crossing over. The camera viewpoint, gray backing blocks, black end-frames and both white domino rows remain fixed throughout this descent. Both cards are still tumbling toward their lower steps as the excerpt ends.
